purpose: Complete Qwen3-30B-A3B seven-batch/nine-arm performance and three-batch/ten-arm quality sequence; one explicit weight format per locked job
deployment_status_at_preparation: LOCAL_ONLY; no deployment, GPU submission or chain modifications
format_semantics: BF16 means no vLLM quantization flag; FP8 means online conversion of the same checkpoint to MoE W8A8. Outer model dtype and auto KV remain BF16. Each format has its own native traces and tuning directory; never reuse BF16 tuning for FP8.
expert_scope: All48 layers are routed MoE, E128/k8/I768 (moe_intermediate_size, not dense intermediate_size6144), first layer0, no shared experts. k/E=1/16. Keep model norm_topk_prob=True; skip renormalization follows the installed router.
graph_scope: Use the deployed smoke_graph CLI for actual B1/2/4/8/16/32/64 with identical capture sizes: no padding, matching the full performance matrix domain. Dense checks native/dense identity separately in eager and graph modes; both dense and marginal retain strict eager/graph output and counter equality. These checks do not establish padded-batch equivalence. Full matrix requires both graph checks and format-specific tuning to pass; the two graph caps allow the larger explicit batch coverage and remain bounded by total remaining time.
dependency_policy: Trace -> corresponding-format native tuning -> graph identity -> full 63 cells. Each eager quality batch needs tuning only and continues independently of other quality or graph failures. Any failed or unrun stage makes the overall run INCOMPLETE.
budget_policy: One format per outer shared-lock job, outer7200/internal7170 seconds; stage caps are clipped to total remaining time, reserve10 seconds for cleanup. No claim that all stages fit before actual Qwen timing exists. Failed/unrun stages remain explicit; full matrix requires both strict exact-bucket graph checks. run_locked enforces the shared total GPU ledger.
energy: Existing bench_graph pairs counter-free performance with independent identical-output counters and records separate NVML decode energy. Actual windows below3s remain diagnostic; fixed N2048 alone does not prove a long enough energy window.
memory: Both weight formats/all arms use .85 of actual GPU total. Known BF16 checkpoint tensor payload56.87051GiB plus B64*(128+2048) BF16 GQA KV12.75GiB =69.62051GiB; approx80.7245GiB budget leaves11.10399GiB before workspace/graph/activation/layout overhead. GPU fit, actual KV capacity, graph capture and FP8 conversion peak remain unprofiled. Never claim FP8 halves KV.
statistics: One performance run per arm and validation32 paired-article quality are exploratory, not independent confirmation; this does not replace task accuracy, natural generation or complete rolling-split PPL.
model_readiness: K-owned target must contain all16 official-revision verified shards plus config/index/tokenizer. No downloading is performed by this runner. Plan-only may use verified local config without weights; runtime config must have identical SHA. No reads/writes to the C checkpoint are required.

reused_driver_structure.adaptation: Same stage/execution structure and shared collection CLIs; Qwen geometry/layer0/config SHA/memory/stage caps and independent deployment entry only. DeepSeek staged/live files untouched.

geometry_resolution: Existing tune_moe.model_geometry plus exact official config SHA. code/model_registry.py was absent at preparation; no parallel registry was invented.
